using Raw = std::string
class Refusal : public std::runtime_error
  const char* word
  std::size_t offset
inline const std::vector<std::string> kLifecycleOperations
inline const std::vector<std::string> kFailureNames
struct NoticeMetadata
  bool quiet
  std::int64_t silence_ns
struct WatchOptions
  std::int64_t every_ns
  std::int64_t budget_ns
struct Stamp
  std::string value
inline std::string encode(const NoticeMetadata& v)
inline NoticeMetadata decode(std::string_view data)
T from_json(std::string_view data)
inline std::string to_json(const NoticeMetadata& v)
inline NoticeMetadata from_json<NoticeMetadata>(std::string_view data)
inline std::string to_json(const WatchOptions& v)
inline WatchOptions from_json<WatchOptions>(std::string_view data)
inline std::string to_json(const Stamp& v)
inline Stamp from_json<Stamp>(std::string_view data)
